<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<title>Ramen</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #060509;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #scene {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
    touch-action: none;
  }
  /* soft vignette that keeps the eye on the bowl */
  body::after {
    content: "";
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 70% at 50% 55%, transparent 40%, rgba(3, 2, 5, 0.78) 100%);
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="scene" role="img" aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen in the dark"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const motionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  let reduced = motionQuery.matches;

  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
  const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v));

  // ---- deterministic random so the arrangement is identical on every load ----
  function mulberry32(a) {
    return () => {
      a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
      let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }
  const rand = mulberry32(20240607);
  const rr = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * rand();
  const onDisc = (rMin, rMax) => {
    const a = rand() * TAU;
    const r = Math.sqrt(rMin * rMin + rand() * (rMax * rMax - rMin * rMin));
    return { u: Math.cos(a) * r, v: Math.sin(a) * r };
  };

  // ---- geometry: heights are in bowl radii, planar coords are unit-disc ----
  const BASE_ELEV = 0.66;   // camera elevation (rad)
  const FOOT_Y = -0.5;      // base of the bowl
  const BROTH_Y = -0.2;     // broth surface
  const BROTH_R = 0.86;     // broth radius (bowl radii)

  // ---- scene content, laid out in broth space (unit disc) ----
  const NOODLES = Array.from({ length: 64 }, () => {
    const x0 = rr(-0.8, 0.8), y0 = rr(-0.8, 0.8), ang = rr(0, TAU);
    const len = rr(0.8, 1.5), amp = rr(0.03, 0.07), ph = rr(0, TAU), k = rr(3, 6);
    const pts = [];
    for (let j = 0; j <= 16; j++) {
      const s = j / 16, along = (s - 0.5) * len, side = Math.sin(ph + s * k) * amp;
      pts.push({
        u: x0 + Math.cos(ang) * along - Math.sin(ang) * side,
        v: y0 + Math.sin(ang) * along + Math.cos(ang) * side,
        s
      });
    }
    return { pts, ph, w: rr(0.85, 1.1) };
  });

  const TOFU = Array.from({ length: 5 }, () => ({ ...onDisc(0.15, 0.7), a: rr(0, TAU), s: rr(0.15, 0.2) }));
  const SHIITAKE = Array.from({ length: 3 }, () => ({ ...onDisc(0.1, 0.55), r: rr(0.09, 0.12) }));
  const BOK = Array.from({ length: 3 }, () => ({ ...onDisc(0.2, 0.6), a: rr(0, TAU), L: rr(0.35, 0.5) }));
  const CORN = [];
  for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
    const hub = onDisc(0.15, 0.6);
    for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++) {
      const a = rand() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rand()) * 0.08;
      CORN.push({ u: hub.u + Math.cos(a) * r, v: hub.v + Math.sin(a) * r });
    }
  }
  const SCALLION = Array.from({ length: 28 }, () => onDisc(0.2, 0.8));
  const NORI = { u: 0.5, v: -0.42, a: -0.3 };
  const SESAME = Array.from({ length: 90 }, () => ({ ...onDisc(0, 0.85), dark: rand() < 0.35 }));
  const CHILI = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => ({ ...onDisc(0.1, 0.6), r: rr(0.03, 0.055), ph: rand() * TAU }));
  const FAT = Array.from({ length: 16 }, () => ({ ...onDisc(0, 0.8), r: rr(0.02, 0.06), ph: rand() * TAU }));
  const WISPS = Array.from({ length: 3 }, () => ({
    ou: rr(-0.35, 0.35), ov: rr(-0.35, 0.35), dx: rr(-0.25, 0.25), h: rr(1.0, 1.5), ph: rand() * TAU
  }));
  const MOTES = Array.from({ length: 70 }, () => ({
    nx: rand(), ny: rand(), sp: rr(0.008, 0.03), r: rr(0.6, 1.8), ph: rand() * TAU, tw: rr(0.6, 1.8)
  }));

  // soft steam sprite, painted once
  const steamSprite = (() => {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = c.height = 128;
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    const gr = g.createRadialGradient(64, 64, 0, 64, 64, 64);
    gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 238, 214, 0.9)');
    gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(255, 222, 188, 0.35)');
    gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 200, 150, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
    return c;
  })();

  // ---- runtime state ----
  let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1, R = 100, CX = 0, CY = 0;
  let yaw = 0, elev = BASE_ELEV, tYaw = 0, tElev = BASE_ELEV;
  let cY = 1, sY = 0, cE = 1, sE = 0;
  let bm = null;               // broth plane matrix from the last draw
  let time = 0, last = 0, raf = 0, spawnAcc = 0;
  const pointer = { x: 0, y: 0, active: false, level: 0, speed: 0, cool: 0, u: 0, v: 0, inBowl: false };
  const ripples = [];
  const steam = [];

  // ---- projection ----
  function camera() {
    cY = Math.cos(yaw); sY = Math.sin(yaw);
    cE = Math.cos(elev); sE = Math.sin(elev);
  }
  function proj(x, y, z) {
    const x1 = x * cY + z * sY;
    const z1 = z * cY - x * sY;
    return [CX + x1 * R, CY - (y * cE - z1 * sE) * R];
  }
  // affine map from a disc of radius r at height Y to screen pixels
  function plane(Y, r) {
    const c = proj(0, Y, 0), a = proj(r, Y, 0), b = proj(0, Y, r);
    return { x: c[0], y: c[1], ax: a[0] - c[0], ay: a[1] - c[1], bx: b[0] - c[0], by: b[1] - c[1] };
  }
  function toPx(m, u, v) {
    return [m.x + u * m.ax + v * m.bx, m.y + u * m.ay + v * m.by];
  }
  function toPlane(m, x, y) {
    const dx = x - m.x, dy = y - m.y;
    const det = m.ax * m.by - m.bx * m.ay;
    return [(dx * m.by - dy * m.bx) / det, (m.ax * dy - m.ay * dx) / det];
  }
  function withPlane(m, fn) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.transform(m.ax, m.ay, m.bx, m.by, m.x, m.y);
    fn();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  // displacement applied near the pointer, so toppings and noodles part for it
  function push(u, v) {
    if (pointer.level < 0.01) return [0, 0];
    const dx = u - pointer.u, dy = v - pointer.v;
    const f = 0.55 * pointer.level * Math.exp(-(dx * dx + dy * dy) / 0.05);
    return [dx * f, dy * f];
  }
  function brothOutline(t) {
    const pts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 72; i++) {
      const a = (i / 72) * TAU;
      const w = 1 + 0.012 * Math.sin(3 * a + t * 1.3) + 0.007 * Math.sin(5 * a - t * 0.9);
      pts.push([Math.cos(a) * w, Math.sin(a) * w]);
    }
    return pts;
  }

  // ---- drawing ----
  function drawBody() {
    const RINGS = 32;
    for (let k = 0; k <= RINGS; k++) {
      const t = k / RINGS;
      const L = 0.5 + 0.5 * t;
      const c = (r, g, b) => `rgb(${(r * L) | 0}, ${(g * L) | 0}, ${(b * L) | 0})`;
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-1, 0, 1, 0);
      g.addColorStop(0, c(2, 6, 6));
      g.addColorStop(0.3, c(34, 80, 76));
      g.addColorStop(0.55, c(16, 46, 44));
      g.addColorStop(1, c(2, 5, 5));
      withPlane(plane(FOOT_Y * (1 - t), 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.pow(t, 0.75)), () => {
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, TAU);
        ctx.fill();
      });
    }
  }

  function drawLip() {
    withPlane(plane(0, 1), () => {
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-1, 0, 1, 0);
      g.addColorStop(0, '#0a1716');
      g.addColorStop(0.35, '#2f6f67');
      g.addColorStop(0.55, '#6fb3a6');
      g.addColorStop(1, '#0a1716');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fill();
    });
    withPlane(plane(0, 0.9), () => {
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -1, 0, 1);
      g.addColorStop(0, '#2e6b62');
      g.addColorStop(0.45, '#0d2624');
      g.addColorStop(1, '#050e0d');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fill();
    });
  }

  function drawNoodles(t, noodlePts) {
    const passes = [
      ['#6b3c12', R * 0.03, 1],
      ['#f1cf86', R * 0.022, 1],
      ['#fff4d2', R * 0.006, 0.8]
    ];
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    for (const [color, width, alpha] of passes) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const pts of noodlePts) {
        pts.forEach(([x, y], i) => (i ? ctx.lineTo(x, y) : ctx.moveTo(x, y)));
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      ctx.strokeStyle = color;
      ctx.lineWidth = width;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawToppings() {
    withPlane(bm, () => {
      // seared tofu
      for (const q of TOFU) {
        const [du, dv] = push(q.u, q.v);
        const s = q.s;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(q.u + du, q.v + dv);
        ctx.rotate(q.a);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#a8612a';
        ctx.fillRect(-s / 2, -s / 2 + 0.012, s, s);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#f0c26e';
        ctx.fillRect(-s / 2, -s / 2, s, s);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 246, 210, 0.55)';
        ctx.fillRect(-s / 2, -s / 2, s, s * 0.3);
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // shiitake slices
      for (const q of SHIITAKE) {
        const [du, dv] = push(q.u, q.v);
        const x = q.u + du, y = q.v + dv, r = q.r;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3a1e0e';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#7b4a25';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - r * 0.12, y - r * 0.12, r * 0.78, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#b9824d';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - r * 0.25, y - r * 0.25, r * 0.3, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
      }

      // bok choy
      for (const q of BOK) {
        const [du, dv] = push(q.u, q.v);
        const L = q.L;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(q.u + du, q.v + dv);
        ctx.rotate(q.a);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-0.045, 0); ctx.lineTo(-0.035, -L * 0.4);
        ctx.lineTo(0.035, -L * 0.4); ctx.lineTo(0.045, 0);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#eef7d4';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-0.035, -L * 0.38);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(-0.2, -L * 0.5, -0.2, -L * 0.9, 0, -L);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(0.2, -L * 0.9, 0.2, -L * 0.5, 0.035, -L * 0.38);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5aa650';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#a9dc8c';
        ctx.fillRect(-0.01, -L * 0.85, 0.02, L * 0.6);
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // nori sheet, half-submerged at the back
      {
        const [du, dv] = push(NORI.u, NORI.v);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(NORI.u + du, NORI.v + dv);
        ctx.rotate(NORI.a);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#142a1d';
        ctx.fillRect(-0.13, -0.19, 0.26, 0.38);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#0a1610';
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) ctx.fillRect(-0.13, -0.16 + i * 0.065, 0.26, 0.008);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2f5a40';
        ctx.fillRect(-0.13, -0.19, 0.26, 0.03);
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // corn kernels
      const cornPts = CORN.map(k => { const [du, dv] = push(k.u, k.v); return [k.u + du, k.v + dv]; });
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const [x, y] of cornPts) { ctx.moveTo(x + 0.03, y); ctx.arc(x, y, 0.03, 0, TAU); }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c531';
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const [x, y] of cornPts) { ctx.moveTo(x - 0.007, y - 0.009); ctx.arc(x - 0.009, y - 0.009, 0.009, 0, TAU); }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff0a6';
      ctx.fill();

      // scallion rounds
      const scPts = SCALLION.map(k => { const [du, dv] = push(k.u, k.v); return [k.u + du, k.v + dv]; });
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const [x, y] of scPts) { ctx.moveTo(x + 0.028, y); ctx.arc(x, y, 0.028, 0, TAU); }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#86c764';
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const [x, y] of scPts) { ctx.moveTo(x + 0.014, y); ctx.arc(x, y, 0.014, 0, TAU); }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f5f9e4';
      ctx.fill();
    });
  }

  function drawSesameAndChili(t) {
    withPlane(bm, () => {
      for (const dark of [false, true]) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (const s of SESAME) {
          if (s.dark !== dark) continue;
          const [du, dv] = push(s.u, s.v);
          ctx.moveTo(s.u + du + 0.011, s.v + dv);
          ctx.arc(s.u + du, s.v + dv, 0.011, 0, TAU);
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = dark ? '#2b1d12' : '#f4e6c2';
        ctx.fill();
      }

      // chili oil drops
      for (const c of CHILI) {
        const [du, dv] = push(c.u, c.v);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(c.u + du, c.v + dv);
        const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, c.r);
        g.addColorStop(0, '#ff8a4a');
        g.addColorStop(0.45, '#d8401e');
        g.addColorStop(0.85, '#7d1307');
        g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(90, 8, 4, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, c.r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 230, 200, ${0.35 + 0.3 * Math.sin(t * 2 + c.ph)})`;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-c.r * 0.3, -c.r * 0.3, c.r * 0.18, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      }
    });
  }

  function drawBrothDetail(t) {
    // fat droplets drifting slowly across the surface
    withPlane(bm, () => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const f of FAT) {
        const x = f.u + Math.sin(t * 0.5 + f.ph) * 0.012;
        const y = f.v + Math.cos(t * 0.4 + f.ph) * 0.012;
        ctx.moveTo(x + f.r, y);
        ctx.arc(x, y, f.r, 0, TAU);
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 244, 214, 0.16)';
      ctx.fill();

      // specular glint that follows the pointer over the broth
      const gu = clamp(-0.35 + (clamp(pointer.u, -0.9, 0.9) + 0.35) * 0.5 * pointer.level + Math.sin(t * 0.3) * 0.04, -0.9, 0.9);
      const gv = clamp(-0.4 + (clamp(pointer.v, -0.9, 0.9) + 0.4) * 0.5 * pointer.level, -0.9, 0.9);
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(gu, gv, 0, gu, gv, 0.3);
      g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 250, 235, 0.9)');
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 240, 200, 0)');
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  }

  function drawRipples() {
    ctx.lineWidth = R * 0.008;
    for (const r of ripples) {
      const fade = 1 - r.age / 1.8;
      for (const [scale, k] of [[1, 1], [0.6, 0.5]]) {
        const rad = (0.04 + r.age * 0.5 * (0.7 + 0.3 * r.s)) * scale;
        const a = clamp(fade * 0.5 * r.s * k, 0, 0.8);
        if (a <= 0.005) continue;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i <= 48; i++) {
          const th = (i / 48) * TAU;
          const [x, y] = toPx(bm, r.u + Math.cos(th) * rad, r.v + Math.sin(th) * rad);
          i ? ctx.lineTo(x, y) : ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        }
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 236, 204, ${a})`;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawWisps(t) {
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    const passes = [[0.06, 0.035], [0.02, 0.05], [0.006, 0.09]];
    for (const w of WISPS) {
      const o = toPx(bm, w.ou, w.ov);
      const SEG = 20;
      for (const [lw, a] of passes) {
        ctx.lineWidth = lw * R;
        for (let i = 0; i < SEG; i++) {
          const s0 = i / SEG, s1 = (i + 1) / SEG;
          const x0 = o[0] + (Math.sin(s0 * 4.2 + t * 0.6 + w.ph) * 0.14 * s0 + w.dx * s0) * R;
          const y0 = o[1] - s0 * w.h * R;
          const x1 = o[0] + (Math.sin(s1 * 4.2 + t * 0.6 + w.ph) * 0.14 * s1 + w.dx * s1) * R;
          const y1 = o[1] - s1 * w.h * R;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 226, 190, ${a * Math.pow(1 - s0, 1.3)})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x0, y0);
          ctx.lineTo(x1, y1);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function drawSteam() {
    for (const p of steam) {
      const k = p.age / p.life;
      const a = Math.min(1, p.age / 1.2) * (1 - k) * p.amp;
      if (a <= 0.005) continue;
      const size = R * (p.s0 + p.age * 0.22);
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.drawImage(steamSprite, p.x - size / 2, p.y - size / 2, size, size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawMotes(t) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(255, 205, 150)';
    for (const m of MOTES) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = (0.25 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * m.tw + m.ph)) * 0.7;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.nx * W, m.ny * H, m.r, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function draw(t) {
    CX = W / 2;
    CY = H * 0.56 + (reduced ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.8) * R * 0.012);
    camera();
    bm = plane(BROTH_Y, BROTH_R);
    locatePointer();

    // background
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#060509';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // warm glow behind the bowl, breathing slowly and drifting with the tilt
    const breathe = reduced ? 1 : 0.92 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 0.9) + 0.03 * Math.sin(t * 2.3);
    const gx = CX - yaw * R * 0.5;
    const gy = CY - R * 0.3 + (elev - BASE_ELEV) * R * 0.5;
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    ctx.globalAlpha = breathe;
    let g = ctx.createRadialGradient(gx, gy, 0, gx, gy, R * 3.2);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 150, 70, 0.24)');
    g.addColorStop(0.3, 'rgba(190, 70, 30, 0.10)');
    g.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(70, 25, 35, 0.03)');
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    g = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.1, H * 0.05, 0, W * 0.1, H * 0.05, Math.max(W, H) * 0.6);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(60, 110, 120, 0.10)');
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

    // warm pool of light on the surface, then the bowl's shadow
    withPlane(plane(FOOT_Y, 2.0), () => {
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
      const p = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1);
      p.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 140, 60, 0.16)');
      p.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 140, 60, 0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = p;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    });
    withPlane(plane(FOOT_Y, 1.3), () => {
      const s = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1);
      s.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)');
      s.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)');
      s.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = s;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    });

    // bowl
    drawBody();
    drawLip();

    // broth surface
    const outline = brothOutline(t);
    withPlane(bm, () => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      outline.forEach(([u, v], i) => (i ? ctx.lineTo(u, v) : ctx.moveTo(u, v)));
      ctx.closePath();
      const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(-0.15, -0.2, 0.05, 0, 0, 1);
      bg.addColorStop(0, '#ffe0a0');
      bg.addColorStop(0.3, '#f2a64a');
      bg.addColorStop(0.65, '#c0621e');
      bg.addColorStop(0.92, '#7a3212');
      bg.addColorStop(1, '#4a1c09');
      ctx.fillStyle = bg;
      ctx.fill();
    });

    // everything floating on the broth is clipped to its surface
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    outline.forEach(([u, v], i) => {
      const [x, y] = toPx(bm, u, v);
      i ? ctx.lineTo(x, y) : ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    });
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.clip();

    drawBrothDetail(t);

    const noodlePts = NOODLES.map(n => n.pts.map(p => {
      const wig = Math.sin(t * 1.1 + n.ph + p.s * 5) * 0.012;
      const wig2 = Math.cos(t * 0.8 + n.ph * 1.7 + p.s * 4) * 0.012;
      const [pu, pv] = push(p.u + wig, p.v + wig2);
      return toPx(bm, p.u + wig + pu, p.v + wig2 + pv);
    }));
    drawNoodles(t, noodlePts);
    drawToppings();
    drawSesameAndChili(t);
    drawRipples();
    ctx.restore();

    // broth edge and a lit back rim
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.beginPath();
    outline.forEach(([u, v], i) => {
      const [x, y] = toPx(bm, u, v);
      i ? ctx.lineTo(x, y) : ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    });
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.lineWidth = R * 0.02;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40, 14, 3, 0.55)';
    ctx.stroke();

    const rimM = plane(0, 1);
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i <= 40; i++) {
      const th = Math.PI * 1.08 + (i / 40) * Math.PI * 0.84;
      const [x, y] = toPx(rimM, Math.cos(th), Math.sin(th));
      i ? ctx.lineTo(x, y) : ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.lineWidth = R * 0.014;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(170, 235, 220, 0.28)';
    ctx.stroke();

    // steam and motes, additive so they glow against the dark
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    drawWisps(t);
    drawSteam();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    drawMotes(t);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // ---- simulation ----
  function locatePointer() {
    if (!bm) return;
    const [u, v] = toPlane(bm, pointer.x, pointer.y);
    pointer.u = u;
    pointer.v = v;
    pointer.inBowl = u * u + v * v < 1;
  }

  function spawnSteam(count, power) {
    if (!bm) return;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * 0.75;
      const [x, y] = toPx(bm, Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r);
      steam.push({
        x, y, age: 0,
        life: 3.6 + Math.random() * 2.4,
        rise: (0.16 + Math.random() * 0.12) * power,
        drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.04,
        wob: 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.4,
        ph: Math.random() * TAU,
        s0: 0.12 + Math.random() * 0.07,
        amp: 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.35
      });
    }
  }

  function stepSteam(dt, rate) {
    if (!bm) return;
    spawnAcc += dt * rate;
    while (spawnAcc >= 1) { spawnAcc -= 1; spawnSteam(1, 1); }
    for (let i = steam.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = steam[i];
      p.age += dt;
      if (p.age >= p.life) {
        steam[i] = steam[steam.length - 1];
        steam.pop();
        continue;
      }
      p.y -= p.rise * R * dt;
      p.x += (Math.sin(p.age * p.wob + p.ph) * 0.07 + p.drift) * R * dt;
    }
  }

  function update(dt) {
    const k = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 3.5);
    yaw += (tYaw - yaw) * k;
    elev += (tElev - elev) * k;
    pointer.level += ((pointer.active ? 1 : 0) - pointer.level) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 6));

    // a ripple trails the pointer while it moves over the broth
    pointer.cool = Math.max(0, pointer.cool - dt);
    if (pointer.active && pointer.inBowl && pointer.speed > 3 && pointer.cool === 0) {
      ripples.push({ u: pointer.u, v: pointer.v, age: 0, s: 0.45 });
      pointer.cool = 0.12;
    }
    pointer.speed = 0;

    for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      ripples[i].age += dt;
      if (ripples[i].age > 1.8) ripples.splice(i, 1);
    }

    stepSteam(dt, pointer.active && pointer.inBowl ? 20 : 12);
    for (const m of MOTES) m.ny = (m.ny - m.sp * dt + 1) % 1;
  }

  function loop(now) {
    const dt = clamp((now - last) / 1000, 0, 0.05);
    last = now;
    time += dt;
    update(dt);
    draw(time);
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // Reduced motion: no animation loop. The scene is rendered as a still frame,
  // and pointer input only changes the pose (applied instantly, no easing).
  function refresh() {
    if (!reduced) return;
    yaw = tYaw;
    elev = tElev;
    pointer.level = pointer.active ? 1 : 0;
    draw(0);
  }

  function retarget() {
    const nx = clamp((pointer.x / W) * 2 - 1, -1, 1);
    const ny = clamp((pointer.y / H) * 2 - 1, -1, 1);
    tYaw = nx * 0.2;
    tElev = BASE_ELEV - ny * 0.1;
    if (reduced) refresh();
  }

  function release() {
    pointer.active = false;
    tYaw = 0;
    tElev = BASE_ELEV;
    if (reduced) refresh();
  }

  // ---- sizing ----
  function resize() {
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    canvas.width = Math.round(W * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(H * dpr);
    R = Math.max(56, Math.min(W * 0.36, H * 0.3));
    steam.length = 0;
    ripples.length = 0;

    if (reduced) {
      yaw = tYaw;
      elev = tElev;
      draw(0);
      // pre-warm the steam so the still frame already shows it
      for (let i = 0; i < 240; i++) stepSteam(1 / 30, 14);
      draw(0);
    } else if (!raf) {
      last = performance.now();
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  }

  // ---- input ----
  window.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
    if (pointer.active) pointer.speed += Math.hypot(e.clientX - pointer.x, e.clientY - pointer.y);
    pointer.x = e.clientX;
    pointer.y = e.clientY;
    pointer.active = true;
    locatePointer();
    retarget();
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
    pointer.x = e.clientX;
    pointer.y = e.clientY;
    pointer.active = true;
    locatePointer();
    if (!reduced && pointer.inBowl) {
      ripples.push({ u: pointer.u, v: pointer.v, age: 0, s: 1.5 });
      spawnSteam(14, 1.6);
    }
    retarget();
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('pointerout', e => { if (!e.relatedTarget) release(); });
  window.addEventListener('pointerup', e => { if (e.pointerType === 'touch') release(); });
  window.addEventListener('pointercancel', release);
  window.addEventListener('blur', release);
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  motionQuery.addEventListener('change', e => {
    reduced = e.matches;
    if (reduced) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = 0;
    }
    resize();
  });

  resize();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

events.content:
I created `/app/index.html`: a single file with inline CSS and JavaScript, no external requests, and no images or raster art. I could not view it in a browser because none is installed here, so I have not checked how it looks. I only checked that it parses and runs for 500+ frames in a stubbed DOM, in both normal and reduced-motion modes.

**What's on screen**
- A vegan ramen bowl in deep teal glaze, seen from above at an angle, filled with amber broth, noodles, seared tofu, shiitake, bok choy, corn, scallion, nori, sesame and chili-oil drops. The whole thing is drawn on a canvas with 3D projection.
- Steam rises in soft additive puffs and faint wisps. A warm glow behind the bowl breathes slowly, and dust motes drift.
- Natural motion: the bowl bobs, noodles sway, fat droplets drift, the broth highlight shifts, and the chili drops shimmer.
- Mouse: the bowl tilts toward the pointer, ripples trail across the broth as the pointer moves over it, and toppings and noodles part near the pointer. The broth highlight follows the pointer. A click sends a larger ripple and a burst of steam.
- No text, UI or menus. Only a CSS vignette sits over the canvas.
- Responsive: the canvas fills the viewport, and the bowl scales to the smaller of width or height. The canvas is capped at 2× device pixel ratio.

**Reduced motion:** the animation loop does not run. The scene renders as a still frame with steam already present. Pointer input still tilts the bowl, but the change is applied instantly with no easing, and ripples and steam bursts are off. If you want the pointer to do nothing at all under reduced motion, that's a one-line change.

**Choices I made:** the arrangement uses a fixed random seed, so it looks the same on every load. I left out chopsticks and any other non-food props so the bowl stays the only focus.

Nothing is committed. `/app` is not a git repository, and you didn't ask for a commit.
